objective: Replace duplicated per-skill evaluation facades with one central evaluator across all 17 skills while preserving generic and specialized behavior, separating behavioral validity from telemetry, making publication privacy-safe and idempotent, and recording compact Git release manifests backed by MLflow evidence.
acceptance_criteria: One central CLI supports run, compare, publish/retry, replay, list, offline development, and strict release workflows.
Fifteen generic skills use shared execution and comparison while Neo and skill-development retain specialized adapters.
Behavioral validity remains independent of telemetry availability, while strict release fails closed on incomplete or inconsistent MLflow evidence.
Default publication is metadata-only, retryable without model reruns, and idempotent at trace, dataset, assessment, and summary boundaries.
Ordinary evaluation evidence has a 365-day policy and adopted or restricted evidence remains protected until superseded plus 365 days; malformed references fail safe.
All 17 packages retain Git-owned definitions and compact release manifests, old generic wrappers and generated result blobs are removed, and specialized assets remain intact.
Repository instructions, scaffold, audit, validators, command mappings, conformance checks, and tests reflect the central interface atomically.
non_goals: No skill behavior, cases, model routes, quality thresholds, or judge criteria redesign.
No MLflow upgrade, rich-content capture, third archive, live evidence deletion, Git-history deletion, deployment, activation, release, publish, merge, or costly model matrix.
No compatibility shim for removed generic wrapper commands and no inference that deferred skills are release-ready.
constraints: Git remains authoritative for definitions and release manifests; MLflow remains authoritative for generated evidence.
No live operational actions are authorized; operational checks requiring credentials, deployment, backup, deletion, or model expenditure remain unexecuted.
The primary Ship state is rooted in nix-config; home-infra candidate identity must be recorded explicitly in verification and review evidence because the Ship CLI hashes one Git root.
Immediate cutover must preserve Neo and skill-development specialized behavior behind adapters and must not delete live evidence.
verification: Focused central evaluator contract, failure-classification, publication idempotency, privacy canary, retention lifecycle, registry, manifest, specialized adapter, scaffold, audit, and Neo tests.
No-model list and replay for every skill plus generic and specialized deterministic smoke paths.
Package inventory, schema and referential integrity, secret and canary scans, Markdown lint, repository build, and home-infra focused tests or static checks.
Fresh independent code review of both repository diffs and recorded verification evidence.
Operational live backup, health, conformance, dry-run, authenticated publication, and model-backed smoke are recorded as unexecuted without explicit authority.
